meridian-core._note: /settings is deliberately NOT allowlisted. It is the target's global fault-injection config; a capability replay must never be able to reach it. The dashboard's fault panel drives it out of band, with its own session, outside the replay path.
meridian-core._thresholdNote: Irreversible steps below this dollar amount run unattended; at or above it they pause for a human. A capability with no currency parameter (Place Account Hold) resolves no amount and therefore always escalates -- a consequence of the fail-closed rule, not a special case.
